onek: Photorealistic, high-resolution documentary architectural photograph of the Tomb of Şehzade Mustafa (1573) in the Muradiye complex, Bursa, Turkey. Soft natural light, crisp detail. No people, no text, no captions, no watermark.

uret.istem: Vertical drone photo: the drone has descended low over the green garden of the Muradiye complex in Bursa seen in the first reference (from above), now looking obliquely down between tall cypress and plane trees at several small domed Ottoman tombs (türbe) built of brick and stone, like the second reference, with old gravestones on the grass. Soft daylight.

bakislar.m: Muradiye Külliyesi'nde II. Murad'dan Cem Sultan'a pek çok hanedan üyesinin türbesi bulunur.

kareler.genisletIstem: The grey area is all ABOVE the photo: fill it only with the tops of the tall cypress and plane trees and a soft cloudy sky. Nothing else; no buildings.

bakislar.m: Kanuni'nin oğlu Şehzade Mustafa 1553'te öldürüldü; başka bir yere gömülen naaşı, II. Selim 1573'te bu türbeyi yaptırınca buraya nakledildi.

uret.istem: Vertical photo. The camera has walked up to the brick-and-stone Ottoman tomb in the reference and now faces its entrance from close by: a portal iwan with a pointed arch whose hood is covered with muqarnas over brick infill, small mihrab niches on both sides of the iwan, windows in pointed arches with marble frames and iron grilles, and in the centre a plain double-leaf wooden door with a flattened arch. Walls of rubble stone courses framed by vertical bricks. Cypress shade, soft light.

bakislar.m: Aslen ahşap sundurmalı olduğu anlaşılan kavsara, tuğla dolgu üzerine mukarnas kaplıdır; eyvanın iki yanında mihrap nişleri var.
Pencereler sivri kemer içine alınmış, mermer söveli ve demir şebekelidir.
Giriş basık kemerli, çift kanatlı sade bir ahşap kapıdan. Kapıdaki talik kitabe: "Sultan Mustafa'nın kabri gül bahçesidir" (1573).

uret.istem: Vertical photo. The wooden double door from the first reference has swung open and the camera is right at the threshold: through the doorway we see the interior of the tomb glowing with blue and turquoise Iznik tiles and white marble cenotaphs, exactly as in the second reference. The door frame, the marble threshold and the shadowy door leaves frame the view.

bakislar.m: Türbeyi II. Selim yaptırdı; hassa mimarlarından Mimar Mehmed Çavuş inşa etti.

uret.istem: Recompose this exact photograph as a vertical 2:3 photo from the same position, with the camera tilted up a little so that above the existing row of pointed arches and windows we see the pendentives and the inside of the single painted dome with a central rosette. Keep the tiles, cenotaphs, windows and colours exactly as in the photo; only one row of arches.

bakislar.m: Bursa türbelerinde genellikle bulunan mihrap bu türbede yoktur.
Duvardaki ayet frizine ve sandukalara gidip buraya döneceğiz.

uret.istem: Vertical close-up photo of the same tomb wall as in the reference: original 16th-century Iznik wall tiles in cobalt blue and turquoise with floral and hexagonal patterns, and a horizontal band of Quranic verses in white thuluth script on cobalt blue, the letters outlined and highlighted with gold gilding. Keep the same composition, sharp detail, soft natural light.

bakislar.m: Türbeyi ötekilerden ayıran en belirgin özellik, altın yaldız işlemeli ayetlerin yazılı olduğu orijinal duvar çinileridir.

uret.istem: Vertical photo, much closer, same position and composition as the reference: the white marble Ottoman cenotaphs (sanduka) in the tomb, carved marble with turban-shaped headstones, in front of the blue and turquoise Iznik tile wall, soft light.

bakislar.m: Şehzade Mustafa'nın yanında annesi Mahidevran Sultan, Şehzade Mehmed ve Şehzade Bayezid'in üç yaşında öldürülen oğlu Şehzade Murad'a ait sandukalar bulunur.

kareler.genisletIstem: Above: the painted upper wall and dome springing with floral ornament. Below: the floor of the tomb. It is the interior of an Ottoman tomb covered in blue Iznik tiles.

bakislar.m: Girişin iki yanındaki duvarların iç köşelerine birer niş ve birer dolap yerleştirilmiştir.

ozet: Uzaydan Muradiye'ye iniş, taç kapıdan içeri; altın yaldızlı çiniler ve sandukalar.

hedef.not: Şehzade Mustafa Türbesi, Muradiye Külliyesi'nin türbeleri arasındadır.
